# Script to generate figure 2A and Suppelemntary 1C


Function to calculate pval and LFC between groups (biological replicates, not technical)
```{r}
# Calculate pval and LFC
get_LFC_pval <- function(data, group1, group2){
  data_1 <- data[data$Sample == group1,]
  data_2 <- data[data$Sample == group2,]
  
  LFC <- mean(data_2$mean)/mean(data_1$mean)
  LFC <- signif(LFC,2)
  
  t_test <- t.test(data_1$mean, data_2$mean)
  pval <- t_test$p.value
  pval <- signif(pval, 2)
  
  return(list(LFC,pval))
}

```


```{r}
cyt <- read.table("../CriptoFc/data/other/cytometry_ 20181004_sup1.csv", header = TRUE, sep=";")
cyt$Value <- as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", gsub("\\.", "", cyt$Value))) # Convert Value to numeric

# Calculate mean and sd of technical replicates
cyt_stats <- cyt %>%
  group_by(Sample, Biological) %>%
  summarize(
    mean = mean(Value),
    sd = sd(Value),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# Get means + SD of biological replicates (from means of technical replicates)
cyt_stats_stats <- cyt_stats %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  summarize(
    CriptoFc_cytometry = mean(mean),
    sd_means = sd(mean),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```


Supplementary 1
Colors from https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/khroma/vignettes/tol.html#sunset
```{r}

######################################################################
# Get labels for LFC and pvalues for transient and stabel comparison
stable <- get_LFC_pval(cyt_stats, "CriptoFc_Expi293", "CriptoFc_Expi293_ULK1KO")
stable_label <- glue('{stable[[1]]}x (pval:{stable[[2]]})')

transient <- get_LFC_pval(cyt_stats, "Transient_CriptoFc_Expi293", "Transient_CriptoFc_Expi293_ULK1KO")
transient_label <- glue('{transient[[1]]}x (pval:{transient[[2]]})')

######################################################################

supp1 <- ggplot(cyt_stats, aes(x = factor(Sample),
                      y = mean,
                      fill = factor(Sample),
                      colour = factor(Sample))) + 
  geom_bar(aes(group = factor(Biological)),
           stat = "identity",
           width = 0.75,
           position = position_dodge(0.9),
           alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - sd, ymax = mean + sd, group = factor(Biological)),
                position = position_dodge(0.9), width = 0.25) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#364B9A", "#98CAE1", "#F67E4B","#FEDA8B")) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#364B9A", "#98CAE1", "#F67E4B","#FEDA8B")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8)) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  labs(x="", y="Cripto-Fc expression", title = "Cripto-Fc expression flow cytometry") +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 1, y = 50000, xend = 2, yend = 50000)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 3, y = 110000, xend = 4, yend = 110000)) +
  annotate(geom = "text", x = 1.5, y = 55000, label = stable_label, hjust = "center") +
  annotate(geom = "text", x = 3.5, y = 115000, label = transient_label, hjust = "center") +
    theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 15, hjust = 0.5), 
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 15), 
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 17),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 17),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 15)
    )

pdf("../CriptoFc/results/barplots/Supplementary_1_bio_replicates.pdf", width = 6, height = 7)  # 6x6 inches
print(supp1)
dev.off()

```


                
Supplementary 1 - merge biological replicates and plot those SDs
```{r}
######################################################################
# Get labels for LFC and pvalues for transient and stabel comparison
stable <- get_LFC_pval(cyt_stats, "CriptoFc_Expi293", "CriptoFc_Expi293_ULK1KO")

transient_label <- glue('{transient[[1]]}x (pval:{transient[[2]]})')

######################################################################

  labs(x="", y="Cripto-Fc expression", title = "Cripto-Fc expression flow cytometry") +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 1, y = 50000, xend = 2, yend = 50000)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 3, y = 110000, xend = 4, yend = 110000)) +
  annotate(geom = "text", x = 1.5, y = 55000, label = stable_label, hjust = "center") +
  annotate(geom = "text", x = 3.5, y = 115000, label = transient_label, hjust = "center") +
    theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 15, hjust = 0.5), 
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 15), 
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 17),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 17),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 15)
    )

pdf("../CriptoFc/results/barplots/Supplementary_1.pdf", width = 6, height = 8)  # 6x6 inches
```
